scope: Owner-authenticated loopback maintenance only. Preview/dry-run by default; explicit plan/checkpoint hashes to apply. No production invocation, learning updates or snapshot rewrite.

sources.episodes: Only explicit changes[].memory assigned to selected actor; archived row id/source/time. Dialogue/speaker/location/current roles do not confer knowledge.
sources.outcomes: Selected actor_id archive rows only; identity/time match and H3 verified fingerprint-v1 evidence. A numeric simulation-outcome summary is derived from archived scenarioId/reward, never a reconstructed historical thought or current scenario title.
sources.legacy: Missing/unsupported evidence or absent explicit recipient is skipped and counted; no reward evidence/witness/role is invented. Ambiguous recipient/source identity collision rejects the batch.

reconciliation: Same stable event/outcome IDs as live memory writers. Preserve all existing rows/text/metadata, including different IDs linked to the same actor/source and legacy rows. Known different source kinds remain separate. Divergent existing content is counted, never rewritten; wrong-owner stable-ID collisions reject.
cursor: Per-job UUID/actor/limit/version compatibility and frozen episode-rowid/actor-experience-seq upper bounds. Bounded pages, then done; new archive appends require a new job. Historical archives are append-only. Each receipt attests the page as read/committed, not a frozen full database content snapshot.
checkpoint: New append-only migration0008 adds dedicated memory_backfill_jobs and memory_backfill_batches. Checkpoint SHA CAS, previous head/plan receipt, counters and phase cursor. Existing migrations/tables/data unchanged.
transaction: One D1 batch conditionally claims checkpoint using previous raw state, exact world revision+JSON, source page/range and memory-scope snapshots. New memories and receipt require that exact nonce. Final receipt NOT NULL assertion rechecks inserted+preserved rows/world/sources, forcing true rollback on invariant failure. No INSERT OR IGNORE hiding lost inserts.
retry: Current committed last-plan+previous-head retry returns duplicate without writes; stale other heads reject. No in-memory lease, scheduler or background backfill.
privacy: Endpoint only owner+local-admin+loopback and same Origin when present, bounded strict body. Preview may return only selected-actor candidate memories for review; CLI stdout/errors are aggregates/hashes/cursor. Optional review JSON is private/exclusive.
verification: Pure source/recipient/evidence and ID reconciliation fixtures.
Actual D1 dry-run has zero writes; apply only inserts missing structured memories plus job/receipts.
World JSON/revision, episodes, experiences, existing memories, policies, home/pets/IDs preserved.
Conflicting plans/checkpoints, source/memory/world changes between preview/apply, concurrency and lost-ACK retries.
Constraint/trigger failure proves full rollback of memory/cursor/receipt, including silently ignored inserts.
Current-range phantom source/memory inserts invalidate CAS; append after frozen bounds excluded.
Fresh build/full unit/type/lint/assets and compiled API; no browser changes.
remaining: Dataset curation/few-shot/DPO with matched prompt/context/model and real validators. Runtime priors and authority-dependent H3b/H5 remain separate.
